_rules: A style is a treatment of the render, never a subject: no object nouns that klein could draw instead of the sketch (no 'toy', 'figurine', 'sign', 'vase').
Each style has: look (how it is rendered, imperative), light, palette, backdrop (plain phrase without 'background').
The subject comes only from the sketch and the optional hint word; the fidelity sentence comes from AI Strength.

styles.label: Natural
styles.look: Photograph it with a real camera in natural daylight, true-to-life materials and textures, 50 mm lens, slight depth of field
styles.palette: true-to-life colors

styles.label: Estudio
styles.look: Photograph it as a clean studio product shot, crisp detail, subtle reflections on the surface it stands on
styles.light: large softbox light with a gentle contact shadow
styles.palette: accurate, slightly muted colors

styles.label: Cine
styles.look: Shoot it like a film still, anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, volumetric haze
styles.light: dramatic side light with a cool rim light
styles.palette: teal shadows and amber highlights

styles.label: 35 mm
styles.look: Shoot it on 35 mm analogue film, fine grain, slightly faded tones, gentle halation on highlights
styles.palette: warm faded colors with soft blacks

styles.label: Hora dorada
styles.look: Photograph it outdoors at golden hour, long soft shadows and a touch of lens flare
styles.palette: gold, amber and deep blue sky

styles.label: Noche
styles.look: Photograph it at night in a city street, neon reflections on wet asphalt, high ISO
styles.palette: cyan and magenta light on dark tones

styles.label: Macro
styles.look: Photograph it as an extreme close-up macro shot, razor-thin focus plane, visible micro texture, creamy bokeh
styles.palette: natural colors

styles.label: Blanco y negro
styles.look: Photograph it in black and white, documentary style, strong contrast and visible grain
styles.palette: pure black and white, no color

styles.label: Arcilla
styles.look: Make it hand-sculpted from modelling clay, fingerprints and tool marks visible, matte surface, photographed on a table
styles.palette: terracotta, cream and sage green clay

styles.label: Cromo
styles.look: Make it mirror-polished liquid chrome, every surface reflecting the room
styles.palette: silver with faint iridescent tints

styles.label: Cristal
styles.look: Make it cast in thick translucent glass, with refractions and caustics on the floor
styles.palette: clear glass tinted amber and teal

styles.label: Madera
styles.look: Make it carved from solid walnut, visible wood grain and smooth sanded edges
styles.palette: honey, amber and dark brown

styles.label: Papel
styles.look: Make it cut and folded from layered colored paper, papercraft with crisp edges and soft paper shadows
styles.palette: coral, mustard, teal and cream paper

styles.label: Neón
styles.look: Make it bent from glowing neon tubes that follow the drawn lines, glow and bloom, colored reflections on the wall
styles.palette: hot pink and electric cyan
styles.backdrop: a dark brick wall at night

styles.label: Acuarela
styles.look: Paint it as a loose watercolor, wet washes bleeding past the lines, pigment blooms, visible paper grain
styles.palette: indigo, rose and ochre washes

styles.label: Tinta
styles.look: Draw it as a confident brush-and-ink illustration, strokes of varying width, hatching, a few splatters
styles.palette: black ink only

styles.label: Óleo
styles.look: Paint it as a thick impasto oil painting, visible brush strokes and palette-knife texture
styles.light: warm gallery light raking across the paint
styles.palette: rich earth tones with a cobalt accent

styles.label: Cartoon
styles.look: Draw it as a bold flat 2D cartoon, thick clean black outlines, flat cel shading, no 3D volume
styles.light: flat light with one simple shadow tone
styles.palette: saturated red, yellow, blue and green fills

styles.label: Pixel
styles.look: Draw it as 16-bit pixel art, chunky square pixels, one-pixel dark outline, two-tone pixel shading
styles.palette: a bright limited 12-color palette

styles.label: Risografía
styles.look: Print it as a two-color risograph, grainy halftone texture, slight misregistration between the colors
styles.palette: fluorescent pink and teal blue ink
